import pandas as pd, json
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, confusion_matrix
tr=pd.read_csv('train.csv'); te=pd.read_csv('test.csv')
rf=RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=200,random_state=42).fit(tr.drop(columns='outcome'),tr.outcome)
p=rf.predict(te.drop(columns='outcome'))
acc=accuracy_score(te.outcome,p); print('test acc',acc); print(confusion_matrix(te.outcome,p))
h=pd.read_csv('holdout_features.csv')
pd.DataFrame({'prediction':rf.predict(h)}).to_csv('predictions.csv',index=False)
